identitySignals: Organization website (elevateoakland.org) names the same organization, Elevate Oakland, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that runs arts and music programs in Oakland public schools
Website names Oakland Unified School District and lists partner schools including Edna Brewer Middle School, which also appears in the OUSD agreement titles for this vendor
Arts and music school programming is consistent with OUSD's after-school and classroom program contracts for this vendor
research.notes: Registry lookups (ProPublica, CA Secretary of State, SAM.gov) could not be completed: ProPublica returned HTTP 429 and the session's web search budget was exhausted. The organization's contact page lists only a web form, with no public phone, email or mailing address. Legal name, EIN and entity number are unconfirmed. Confidence is medium because identity rests on the organization's own website only; a registry check would likely raise it to high.

profile.summary: Elevate Oakland is a nonprofit organization founded in 2011 that brings arts and music programs to Oakland youth through school partnerships. It provides musical instruments, artist residencies, live performances with professional musicians, and speaker series.
